technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but severely undermined by price below all key moving averages, weak trend structure (ADX 22), and bearish momentum indicators; low-probability entry without additional confirmation.

fundamental.summary: FE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 27 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (321), rising dollar, and credit stress creates hostile environment for utilities; earnings in 27 days adds binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic RSI oversold with bullish cross, Williams %R oversold, and supertrend bullish create technical bounce setup at support (32.68) in extreme fear environment (16/100 fear-greed).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (9/21/50/200), weak ADX trend (22.1), bearish momentum (MACD histogram, AO negative, force index negative), crisis VIX (321), inverted yield curve, and earnings binary event in 27 days create hostile macro backdrop that overwhelms oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Stochastic RSI oversold bounce with supertrend bullish at support (32.68) offers technical setup, but price remains trapped below all major moving averages with weak trend structure (ADX 22) and bearish momentum across MACD, AO, and force index.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 27 days combined with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (321), and rising credit spreads create hostile macro environment that can invalidate oversold technicals; price below all key MAs suggests downtrend continuation risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 23 positions in Utilities sector (17% of portfolio); adding FE increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without fundamental or smart money support.
